info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Interface — WAN, Serial & Aggregation
info.description:
WAN, serial and link aggregation interface configuration.

**Types covered (17):** Serial, Serial-subinterface, ATM, ATM-subinterface, ATM-ACR, ATM-ACRsubinterface, CEM, CEM-ACR, Dialer, Cellular, Multilink, Group-Async, Async, MFR, MFR-subinterface, Port-channel, Port-channel-subinterface

**Common use cases:** Serial/T1 WAN links, ATM ADSL, cellular failover, EtherChannel/LAG, dial backup

**YANG:** Cisco-IOS-XE-native interface container + augments from serial, policy, atm, etc.

get.description:
Retrieve all Serial interface configurations.

CLI equivalent: `show running-config | section interface Serial`

Returns a list of Serial interfaces with their name (key), IP addressing, shutdown state, description, and augmented features (QoS service-policy, ACL bindings, etc.).

patch.description: Merge update to Serial interface configurations.
